summary: @servicetitan/cp-mfe preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated 727 KB payload
details: package.json declares preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<archive>.zip to a temporary directory, chmods the extracted binary executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against the sibling file math_init.js (or execs `bun math_init.js` directly if Bun is already on PATH). math_init.js is ~727 KB of heavily obfuscated JavaScript using a rotated string-array dispatcher (WV8StW / MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())) and a large opcode/constants table (n7gIxM = [...]) with hex-mangled identifiers. The package advertises itself as a React micro-frontend library and its dist/index.js only re-exports two small modules; there is no legitimate library reason to fetch an alternate language runtime at install time to execute an obfuscated payload. The alternate-runtime path also evades scanners that inspect only Node-resolvable code. Installing this package causes attacker-controlled obfuscated code to run on the installer's machine during `npm install` via the preinstall lifecycle hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
